relevance.rationale: This is the paper that puts the A-polynomial inside SL(2,C) Chern-Simons theory: it quantises the A-polynomial as a Lagrangian submanifold (sec. 3.1), states a one-parameter generalised volume conjecture whose m = 1 specialisation is the ordinary volume conjecture (sec. 5.2), proves it for the figure-eight by saddle point (sec. 5.3), and derives the colored-Jones/A-polynomial relation (sec. 5.4). prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification asserts precisely that Phi_q and Li_2^q are two saddle-point regimes of the AJ operator equation A-hat . J_N = 0; its cites list carries garoufalidis2004 (the algebraic AJ side) and champanerkar2003 but nothing for the Chern-Simons saddle-point side, which is the half of the claim this paper supplies. Core because the block's central move -- 'saddle-point regimes of the AJ machinery' -- is this paper's subject, not merely adjacent to it.

keyResults.statement: The classical A-polynomial's zero locus is the Lagrangian of the SL(2,C) Chern-Simons phase space, and its quantisation governs a one-parameter family of colored-Jones asymptotics (Vol(l,m) + i 2 pi^2 CS(l,m)) that contains the volume conjecture at m = 1.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies the Chern-Simons saddle-point reading of the AJ operator that prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification asserts but sources only on the algebraic side.

keyResults.statement: The generalised volume conjecture is verified for the figure-eight knot by explicit saddle-point analysis of the N-colored Jones sum.
keyResults.useForFolio: The corpus's 4_1 saddle (rem:dilog-saddle-regime, now Lean-discharged) is the m = 1 point of this computation; a citation records that the framework's 4_1 anchor sits inside a published one-parameter family rather than being an isolated coincidence.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry; the corpus has gukov-stosic2012, gorsky-gukov-stosic2013 and gukov-pei-putrov-vafa2017 but not this, which is the origin of the quantum-A-polynomial/Chern-Simons reading it relies on.
prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification's saddle-point framing is uncited; garoufalidis2004 covers the q-difference operator, not the Chern-Simons asymptotics that make 'saddle regime' meaningful.

The generalised (one-parameter) volume conjecture strictly contains the Kashaev statement the corpus adopts; a remark recording that containment would place the corpus's 4_1 anchor in its published family.
